## What's changed

- Added detailed Android TV decoder capability negotiation for H.264, HEVC, VP9, and AV1.
- Used each device's reported codec profile, level, bit depth, resolution, and frame-rate limits when deciding whether video can direct play.
- Kept capability detection local to Google TV startup so playback does not gain another network check or per-item delay.
- Preserved the existing Steam, Apple TV, and retro-player playback paths; the new limits apply only to capability-version 7 Android TV players.
